duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Nanjing Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2305 USD/per year ￥ 16600 CNY/per year

materials.text: • Passport (valid for more than one year, if you are currently in China, please provide the first page of the passport and the page of the residence permit).• Notarized certificate of the highest academic qualification. If you are a current student, a certificate of expected graduation or proof of enrollment issued by the school you are studying in must be submitted (and after being admitted the graduation certificate and degree certificate must be submitted).• Academic transcripts (from undergraduate level). Documents in other than Chinese and English must be accompanied by notarized translations in Chinese or English.• Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must provide proof of Chinese proficiency. New HSK Level 5 (above 180 points) is required for master's degree and New HSK Level 6 (above 180 points) is required for doctoral application.• Applicants for English-taught majors need to provide TOEFL/IELTS score certificate or proof of English-taught education from the previous degree, with a TOEFL score of 85 or above, and an IELTS score of 6.5 or above.• 2 recommendation letters.（Master's and doctoral applicants）• The study plan during the postgraduate period, written in Chinese/English, more than 1,000 words, which should focus on the applicant's willingness to study in China, understanding of China and Chinese institutions, as well as the background of the previous academic institution and his own disciplinary background, research direction and expected research results.• Physical examination form (the examination results are valid for 6 months).• Non-criminal record, which should be a supporting document within 6 months before the date of submitting the application.• Students applying to study music and art majors should provide their own works.

requirements.text: The Applicant must be a foreign citizen, above 18 years old, in good physical and mental health, friendly to China, and of good character.
